name: SDF-based Volume Rendering
aliases: SDF-based Volume Rendering — NeuS Opacity Derivation, SDF-to-Opacity via Sigmoid
definition: Converts SDF predictions to opacity for volume rendering using a logistic function (sigmoid) to allow optimization with neural volume rendering.
summary: SDF-based Volume Rendering uses a neural network to represent scenes as implicit Signed Distance Fields, converting SDF values into opacity via logistic mapping to ensure accurate surface reconstruction and photo-realistic rendering.
